ev.q: In this study, adjusted VE was 75% for 1 dose and 86% for 2 doses of JYNNEOS vaccine
Among 1,414 respondents, 1,127 (86.1%) met the minimum data element requirements
Adjusted VE was 75.2% (95% CI = 61.2% to 84.2%) for partial vaccination (1 dose)
Each case-patient was matched with up to four control patients based on state or region
VE estimates were stratified a priori by immunocompromise status and route of vaccine administration
The adjusted model accounted for covariates identified a priori, including age, race and ethnicity
A matched case-control study was conducted in 12 U.S. jurisdictions.

methods_quotes.q: Conditional logistic regression models were used to estimate crude and adjusted odds ratios evaluating the association between vaccination status and case- or control patient status.
VE was calculated as (1 – odds ratio) x 100%.
VE estimates were stratified a priori by immunocompromise status and route of vaccine administration
Each case-patient was matched with up to four control patients based on state or region
